subject: Signal and System
questionText:
An excitation is applied to a system at t = T and its 
response is zero for –∞ < t < T. Such a system is 
 
(a) Non-causal system 
 
(b) Stable system 
 
(c) Causal system 
 
(d) Unstable system
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-06 (Types of System).
